points.description: Names the convolutional layer (kernels/filters convolving over the input image) together with an activation layer (e.g. ReLU) as the feature-extraction part of the network. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the convolutional layer or only the activation layer is given.

points.description: Names a pooling layer (max or average pooling) and one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax (output) layer. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the pooling layer or only the fully connected/softmax part is given.
